basis: Inspected ide/README.md and terminal adapters; reconcile against current mounted implementation at Gate 0. Operations below are responsibilities, not invented endpoint schemas. Gate 0 populated copy: current_consumer filled from source at worktree revision 287997fc (ide/ and src/ identical to 4240360b); candidate_consumer, status and verified_source_revision intentionally left unfilled; entries P16 onward are capabilities the starting register did not list and carry empty acceptance_references because the source does not map them.

entries.existing_owner: Theorem workspace connection and outer route
entries.required_parity: Workspace/project identity, environment display and permission scope survive replacement; files refer to the correct execution environment.

entries.existing_owner: SDK workspace file operations and live changes
entries.required_parity: Real listing/search/reveal and supported file mutations reach the existing owner; unavailable operations remain explicit.

entries.existing_owner: SDK DocumentSession
entries.required_parity: Pending edits, conflicts, save and per-client undo remain usable; no second writer or lost local edits.

entries.existing_owner: DocumentSession plus the selected ELY port
entries.required_parity: Visual, Source, Split and Preview refer to the same source and preserve unsupported source constructs and concurrent edits.

entries.existing_owner: SDK WorkspaceLanguage and host language services
entries.required_parity: Completion/definition/diagnostics/format/rename retain document revision and workspace scope; returned edits use the authoritative apply path.

entries.existing_owner: SDK WorkspaceScm
entries.required_parity: Staged/unstaged/conflict state, diff, stage, unstage, commit and supported branch/remote operations remain reachable through the chosen Changes UI.

entries.existing_owner: Existing run operations and output owner
entries.required_parity: Start/stop/configuration/output target the selected environment; view closure does not terminate work implicitly.

entries.existing_owner: Existing history/navigation and reference operations
entries.required_parity: History/log and supported source-range reveal remain reachable; adding a selection sends a typed scoped reference.

entries.existing_owner: SDK TerminalChannel and host native PTY
entries.required_parity: Input, byte stream, resize, copy/search, resets, detach and explicit kill retain their behavior and truthful host-lifetime limits.

entries.existing_owner: Existing terminal profile/capability path
entries.required_parity: Herdr shell and configured external-agent profiles remain explicit and readiness-gated, with no native fallback.

entries.existing_owner: Theorem terminal registry and Herdr Core adapter
entries.required_parity: Binding epochs, adoption, snapshots, stream offsets, input and resize from any view, process identity and replacement semantics reach the new consumer.

entries.existing_owner: Existing Follow/reveal and typed reference bridge
entries.required_parity: Following actual agent navigation and user pause/override remain explicit; opening another file does not corrupt the current draft.

entries.existing_owner: Existing appearance/account configuration and browser owner
entries.required_parity: Mapped layouts and preferences restore safely without starting processes; themes retain drafts, focus and resource identity.

entries.existing_owner: Existing artifact contributions/renderer and approved cabinet contract
entries.required_parity: Project artifacts retain revision identity, preview modes, originals, visibility and running editor state.

entries.existing_owner: Theo web route and Theia build owners
entries.required_parity: Actual supported workflows have replacement paths before obsolete Theia routes/dependencies are removed; migration/rollback is recorded.
entries.current_consumer: src/routes/_chat/ide.tsx; src/routes/theia/$.ts; vite.config.ts:108-150; scripts/build-cloudflare.sh:31-34; ide/package.json; ide/patches/; eslint.config.js:42; tsconfig.json (excludes ide); .prettierignore:5

entries.existing_owner: SDK WorkspaceLanguage diagnostics and Theia ProblemManager
entries.required_parity: Diagnostics for an open document are bound to its revision and dropped when stale or while edits are pending; severities error, warning, info, hint; refreshed on file change and resync.

entries.existing_owner: Host search operations
entries.required_parity: Text search with regex, case, whole-word, include/exclude, continuation and cancel. Replace is reachable in Theia UI but has no bound host path today; decide parity or deprecation explicitly.

entries.capability: Blame, file history and revision restore
entries.existing_owner: Host scm.blame, scm.log, history.* operations
entries.required_parity: Line blame toggle, file history list, git log entries, open a past revision, restore a revision, with empty-state behavior for files unknown to the journal or git. Listed in P06/P08 only implicitly.

entries.existing_owner: Host terminal.kill (not on origin/main)
entries.required_parity: End the host process of a terminal, distinct from detaching; offered only when the host advertises terminal.kill.

entries.capability: Chat mirror, approvals and change sets in the frame
entries.existing_owner: Parent conversation via IdeHostMethods
entries.required_parity: The in-frame Theorem chat agent mirrors the parent conversation: send, cancel, approval decisions with settled state, thread and artifact open, change-set elements with admission states.

entries.existing_owner: chat.runs.delegations and delegationContent
entries.required_parity: Read-only before/after documents per delegation change, open-changes from the parent, missing-content state, binary changes skipped.

entries.capability: Connection status, recovery and capability negotiation
entries.existing_owner: TheoremConnection, workspace-recovery, host capabilities
entries.required_parity: Workspace open/reopen, retry schedule 1/2/4/8/15/30 s, resync handling, stale_revision reseat, offers() and capabilities gating, connection status shown to the parent with a retry action.

entries.capability: Syntax grammars and Theia-local editor features
entries.existing_owner: Theia/Monaco in the browser, no host operation
entries.required_parity: TextMate highlighting for 29 language ids and Monaco-local features (find/replace in file, multi-cursor, command palette, keybindings and preferences UI, outline) that no host operation backs.

entries.capability: Frame chrome, layout and status bar mirroring
entries.existing_owner: zed-look extension and parent IDE panel state
entries.required_parity: Embedded layout, title bar, dock buttons, status bar, side-panel and sidebar state, explorer menu, fonts, and the frame-to-parent status bar mirror.

entries.capability: Parent IDE surfaces and entry points
entries.existing_owner: Parent app shell and builtins module
entries.required_parity: IDE shell modes, the theorem.ide module with its chat setting (own/conversation/terminal/page), sessions-panel file tree and IDE toggle, Open in IDE links, and the terminal-screen reveal action.

entries.capability: File copy and binary file writes
entries.existing_owner: Host workspace.files.copy (not advertised on origin/main)
entries.required_parity: Copy and paste of files and binary writes in the explorer; today refused with Unavailable when the host does not offer workspace.files.copy.

entries.capability: SDK vendoring and Theia patch set
entries.existing_owner: Build owner
entries.required_parity: The vendored @theoremharness/sdk tarballs (alpha.3 in ide/, alpha.5 at the repo root) and Theia/native patches are shared build inputs to retire or keep with the build.
